mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_statuses ( student_course_id, status ) VALUES ( #{studentCourseId}, #{status} )

mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, sc.course_name AS courseName, aps. status AS status FROM application_statuses aps JOIN students_courses sc ON aps.student_course_id = sc.id JOIN students s ON sc.student_pk = s.id WHERE aps.student_course_id = #{studentCourseId}
